title: Elizabeth Rauscher's ONI grant and her Berkeley archive

tellings.quote: She passed away, but they got like this huge grant from the the ONI. And I was like, you know, looking everywhere to try to find documents, she has a huge archive at Berkeley of all of her research, and I I had someone go there and look, and we couldn't find anything,

plain: The physicist Elizabeth Rauscher, who worked with the researcher Andrija Puharich, is said to have received a big grant from the Office of Naval Intelligence, the Navy's spy agency, sometime in the 1970s or early 1980s. The researcher Greg Malatzi says that after she died he searched for any papers about it, even sending someone through her large research archive at Berkeley, but they found nothing. To him, the missing papers suggest the Navy-funded work was kept out of the record.
